docs.subject: Office redesign
docs.body:
Dear Ms. Chen,

Thank you for meeting with me on Tuesday to discuss the redesign of your company's offices. As promised, I have attached two preliminary floor plans. The first keeps your current number of private offices, while the second replaces four of them with an open area and two small meeting rooms.

Both options remain within the budget you mentioned. However, the second would require moving the kitchen, which would add about three weeks to the construction schedule.

I would be happy to present both plans to your management team. I am available any afternoon next week except Thursday.

Best regards,
Rafael Ortiz

questions.prompt: Why did Mr. Ortiz write the e-mail?
options: To follow up on a meeting
questions.evidence: Thank you for meeting with me on Tuesday
questions.explanation: Il fait suite à la réunion de mardi en envoyant les plans promis.
questions.takeaway: As promised = comme promis (suite d'un échange).

questions.prompt: What is a drawback of the second plan?
options: It would take longer to complete.
It reduces the number of meeting rooms.
It requires a new kitchen supplier.
questions.evidence: add about three weeks to the construction schedule
questions.explanation: Déplacer la cuisine ajouterait environ trois semaines au chantier.
questions.traps: (A) est faux : les deux options respectent le budget.

questions.prompt: When would Mr. Ortiz be unable to present the plans next week?
questions.evidence: I am available any afternoon next week except Thursday.
questions.explanation: Il est disponible tous les après-midi sauf jeudi.

docs.title: Hendricks Tools Opens Training Academy
docs.body:
MILWAUKEE — Hendricks Tools, a manufacturer of professional power tools, will open a training academy for electricians and carpenters next month. The academy, located in a renovated warehouse next to the company's main factory, will offer free courses on the safe use of power tools, as well as paid certification programs. [1]

Company president Diane Hendricks said the idea came from customer feedback. "Many of our customers told us that young workers were entering the trades without enough hands-on experience," she said. [2]

The academy will be able to train up to 1,500 people per year. [3] Registration for the first courses opens on the company's website on May 1. [4]

questions.prompt: What is the article mainly about?
options: A company opening a training facility
A new line of power tools
questions.evidence: will open a training academy for electricians and carpenters
questions.explanation: L'article annonce l'ouverture d'une académie de formation par un fabricant d'outils.

questions.prompt: According to Ms. Hendricks, why was the academy created?
options: The company needed to use an empty warehouse.
Customers noticed that young workers lacked practical experience.
questions.evidence: young workers were entering the trades without enough hands-on experience
questions.explanation: Les clients ont signalé que les jeunes manquaient d'expérience pratique (« hands-on experience »).

questions.prompt: In which of the positions marked [1], [2], [3], and [4] does the following sentence best belong? "Several local technical schools have already agreed to send their students."
questions.explanation: Après la capacité d'accueil (1 500 personnes par an), la phrase indique d'où viendront déjà des stagiaires : les écoles techniques locales.
questions.traps: [4] suit l'ouverture des inscriptions en ligne, ce qui rend l'ajout moins naturel.
questions.takeaway: Cherche la phrase qui prépare logiquement l'information insérée.

docs.subtitle: To: Dr. Kai Albrecht — Membership renewal
docs.body:
Dear Dr. Albrecht,

Your membership in the European Society of Logistics Professionals expires on 31 January. To ensure uninterrupted access to our member benefits, including our quarterly journal, online job board, and reduced conference fees, please renew before that date.

This year, members who renew for two years instead of one will pay €310 rather than €340, a saving of nearly ten percent. Renewal can be completed online in a few minutes at eslp.eu/renew.

Please note that our annual conference will take place in Vienna from 14 to 16 May. Members who renew by 31 January will also receive priority registration.

Kind regards,
Membership Office

docs.title: Secondhand Clothing Moves into the Mainstream
docs.body:
Once limited to charity shops and flea markets, secondhand clothing is now sold by some of Europe's largest fashion retailers. Last spring, Maison Vela began selling used garments in twenty of its stores, and the results have exceeded expectations. [1]

According to a recent survey by the consulting firm Retail Insight, nearly 40 percent of shoppers under thirty bought at least one secondhand item last year. Price is the main reason, but many respondents also cited environmental concerns. [2]

Not everyone is convinced, however. Some analysts warn that resale could reduce sales of new clothing, which still generate most of the industry's profits. [3] Others argue that customers who sell their old garments back to a store tend to spend the credit they receive on new items. [4]

questions.prompt: What is the article mainly about?
options: The growing popularity of used clothing
questions.evidence: secondhand clothing is now sold by some of Europe's largest fashion retailers
questions.explanation: L'article décrit l'essor des vêtements d'occasion chez les grandes enseignes.

questions.prompt: The word "cited" in paragraph 2, line 3, is closest in meaning to
questions.evidence: many respondents also cited environmental concerns
questions.explanation: « Cite a reason » = mentionner une raison. Le sens est « mentioned ».
questions.traps: « Quoted » (citer textuellement) correspond à un autre sens de « cite ».

questions.prompt: What concern do some analysts express?
options: Used clothing may be of poor quality.
Sales of new clothing could decline.
questions.evidence: resale could reduce sales of new clothing
questions.explanation: Certains analystes craignent que la revente fasse baisser les ventes de vêtements neufs.

questions.prompt: In which of the positions marked [1], [2], [3], and [4] does the following sentence best belong? "The company now plans to extend the program to all of its 140 stores."
questions.explanation: « The company » renvoie à Maison Vela, dont on vient de dire que les résultats ont dépassé les attentes : l'extension du programme suit logiquement.
questions.takeaway: Les reprises (the company, this program) pointent vers la phrase précédente.

docs.subject: Annual health check — new procedure
docs.body:
Dear colleagues,

This year's occupational health checks will take place from 22 September to 3 October in the medical room on the ground floor. Unlike in previous years, appointments will no longer be assigned automatically. Instead, each employee must book a slot through the HR portal by 15 September.

Each appointment lasts about twenty minutes and includes a vision and hearing test. Employees who work night shifts may request an appointment between 6 and 8 A.M. by contacting Julie Mercier directly.

Please bring your vaccination record if you have one. Employees who do not book a slot by the deadline will be assigned one by HR.

Best regards,
Human Resources

questions.prompt: What is the main purpose of the e-mail?
options: To explain a change in how appointments are made
To announce the opening of a medical room
To introduce a new HR employee
questions.evidence: appointments will no longer be assigned automatically
questions.explanation: Le mail explique que les rendez-vous ne sont plus attribués automatiquement : chacun doit réserver.
questions.takeaway: Unlike in previous years = contrairement aux années précédentes.

questions.prompt: What must employees do by 15 September?
questions.evidence: each employee must book a slot through the HR portal by 15 September
questions.explanation: Chacun doit réserver un créneau sur le portail RH avant le 15 septembre.
questions.takeaway: Book a slot = réserver un créneau.

questions.prompt: Why would an employee contact Ms. Mercier?
options: To report a problem with the portal
questions.evidence: may request an appointment between 6 and 8 A.M. by contacting Julie Mercier directly
questions.explanation: Les salariés de nuit peuvent demander un rendez-vous entre 6 h et 8 h auprès de Julie Mercier.

questions.prompt: What will happen if an employee does not book by the deadline?
options: The health check will be canceled.
HR will choose an appointment for the employee.
The employee will pay a fee.
The employee will be contacted by a doctor.
questions.evidence: will be assigned one by HR
questions.explanation: Les RH attribueront un créneau aux retardataires.

docs.title: Internal Job Opening — Customer Success Manager (Madrid office)
docs.body:
Kestrel Software is seeking a Customer Success Manager to support our corporate clients in Spain and Portugal. The successful candidate will lead onboarding for new clients, run quarterly account reviews, and identify opportunities for additional sales.

Requirements: at least two years in a client-facing role at Kestrel; fluency in Spanish and English (Portuguese is a plus); willingness to travel up to one week per month.

Internal applicants should submit a short cover letter and their most recent performance review to Carmen Ruiz (HR) by 10 March. Shortlisted candidates will be interviewed by the regional director the week of 17 March.

docs.subject: Customer Success Manager
docs.body:
Dear Ms. Ruiz,

I would like to apply for the Customer Success Manager position in Madrid. I have worked on Kestrel's support desk in Lisbon for the past three years, where I handle calls from clients in Portugal and Brazil, as well as some in Spain.

Spanish is my second language, and I use it daily with clients. I have attached my cover letter. However, my performance review from last year is still being finalized by my manager, Ana Sousa, who is on leave until 12 March. Could I submit it as soon as she returns?

Best regards,
Tiago Mendes

questions.prompt: What is one responsibility of the position?
options: Leading the onboarding of new clients
questions.evidence: lead onboarding for new clients
questions.explanation: Le poste consiste notamment à accompagner l'intégration des nouveaux clients.

questions.prompt: In the e-mail, the word "handle" in paragraph 1, line 2, is closest in meaning to
questions.evidence: where I handle calls
questions.explanation: « Handle calls » = traiter des appels, s'en occuper : « deal with ».

questions.prompt: Which requirement does Mr. Mendes clearly meet?
options: Experience in a client-facing role at Kestrel
questions.explanation: L'offre exige deux ans dans un poste en contact avec les clients chez Kestrel ; il travaille au support client depuis trois ans.
questions.takeaway: Compare chaque exigence avec le profil décrit.

questions.prompt: What qualification does Mr. Mendes most likely have that the job posting describes as a plus?
questions.explanation: Il travaille à Lisbonne, avec des clients du Portugal et du Brésil, et l'espagnol est sa deuxième langue : le portugais est très probablement sa langue maternelle. L'offre le présente comme un atout.
questions.traps: L'anglais est une exigence, pas un atout.
questions.takeaway: Inférence croisée : combine indices et critères.

questions.prompt: Why might Mr. Mendes's application be incomplete by the deadline?
options: His manager will return after the deadline.
He has not written a cover letter.
He has not worked at Kestrel long enough.
The regional director is on leave.
questions.explanation: La date limite est le 10 mars ; sa responsable, qui finalise son évaluation, est absente jusqu'au 12 mars.
questions.takeaway: Compare les dates des deux documents.

docs.title: Call for Speakers — Green Supply Chain Forum 2027
docs.body: The Green Supply Chain Forum (Rotterdam, 8–9 June) invites proposals for 30-minute presentations on sustainable logistics. Topics of particular interest include electric fleets, packaging reduction, and carbon reporting. Proposals of no more than 300 words must be submitted through our website by 15 February. Speakers whose proposals are accepted will receive free admission to the forum, valued at €650, but are responsible for their own travel costs.

docs.subject: Proposal: Reusable packaging at scale
docs.body:
Dear Program Committee,

Please find below a summary of my proposed presentation. As head of operations at Pallo Logistics, I led the switch from cardboard to reusable plastic crates across our 14 warehouses, which cut packaging waste by 62 percent in two years. My talk would explain the costs, the challenges, and how we persuaded our clients to take part.

I tried to submit this through your website, but the form returned an error message each time I clicked "Send." I hope submitting by e-mail is acceptable.

Kofi Boateng

docs.subject: RE: Proposal: Reusable packaging at scale
docs.body:
Dear Mr. Boateng,

We are pleased to inform you that your proposal has been accepted. Thank you also for letting us know about the website problem; it has since been fixed. Your presentation is scheduled for 9 June at 11:00 in Hall B. Please send us your slides by 25 May so that our technical team can test them in advance.

The Program Committee

questions.prompt: Which topic of particular interest does Mr. Boateng's proposal address?
questions.explanation: Sa présentation porte sur le passage à des caisses réutilisables qui a réduit les déchets d'emballage : c'est la réduction des emballages.
questions.takeaway: Reformule le sujet du doc 2 avec les catégories du doc 1.

options: It was submitted through the website.

questions.explanation: Envoyée le 12 février, avant la date limite du 15 février.
questions.traps: (B) est faux : il l'a envoyée par e-mail.
questions.takeaway: Compare date d'envoi et date limite.

options: A website was not working properly.
questions.evidence: the form returned an error message each time I clicked
questions.explanation: Le formulaire du site affichait un message d'erreur à chaque envoi.

docs.subject: Upgrade question
docs.body:
Hello,

Our studio has been using TaskFlow on the Starter plan for a year, and we love it. However, we've just hired three new designers, bringing our team to eight people, and our files now take up about 150 GB. Which plan would you recommend?

Also, we've had trouble syncing the mobile app with our project calendar since your latest update. Is this a known issue?

Thank you for being a loyal customer. Based on the number of users and the storage you need, the plan that fits your needs best is one level above your current plan. If you switch to annual billing, you will also save the equivalent of two months.
